sections.changelog:
Changed

  • Migrated admin UI to MVweb Admin UI Kit v2 (slate palette, Yoast-style sidebar layout).
  • Rewrote settings page and all tabs (General, Packaging, WooCommerce, Analytics, Help) using current UI Kit components.
  • Updated bundled MVweb Menu to v2.5.0 (newest-wins loader, plugin catalog).
  • Admin asset versions now use `filemtime()` cache-busting.
  • WooCommerce integration now loads via `class_exists( 'WooCommerce' )` on `plugins_loaded` (reliable on multisite) instead of scanning `active_plugins`.
  • Cleaned up internal references in `admin/css/admin.css` PHPDoc header; rebuilt minified assets.

Fixed (hardening)

  • Calculator packaging `
  • Escaped tab CSS-class output with `esc_attr()` in the settings page.
  • `save_packaging()` guards `packaging_label` / `packaging_category` / `packaging_enabled` with `is_array()` before iterating.

Added

  • Plugin logo (`images/mv-logo-violet.png`) for the MVweb Hub hero.
  • `README.md` and `build:locale` npm script.

Fixed

  • `uninstall.php` now drops the analytics table via `$wpdb->prepare()` with the `%i` placeholder.
  • MVweb Menu: replaced non-existent `mvweb-badge--neutral` with `mvweb-badge--plain` for inactive plugins.
  • Localization: regenerated `.pot` and synced `ru_RU.po`/`.mo` after the UI rewrite (265 strings, no untranslated) — admin block titles introduced during the migration now display in Russian.
  • UI Kit: added the missing `.mvweb-tab-content` / `.mvweb-tab-content.active` display rules so only the active settings tab is shown (previously all tabs rendered at once). Fixed in both the bundled `admin.css` and the boilerplate.
